Current Structure  
• Current trading price is $2.50, sitting in a deep capitulation zone between $1.63 and $2.56 relative to its fair value.  
• The 20‑week SMA is flat and has been below the price since 2024, with risk levels dropping from an elevated 66 to 6 in recent months.  
• Composite risk score is 4000, placing ICP below the median risk threshold for golden breakout assets.  
• Social‑sentiment word‑cloud momentum shows a 10% 90‑day ROI and move consistency >50%, confirming its breakout status outside the top‑20 cap cryptos.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
• Time‑Weighted Average (TWA) places ICP at an 8/100 risk level, with the price deviating 82% from the lifetime average calculated from 2021 data.  
• Polynomial regression fair value is $4.00; the current price of $2.50 is ~2 standard deviations below fair value, indicating deep undervaluation.  
• The 20‑week SMA risk has fallen below 6, while the 100‑ and 200‑week SMAs remain well below the price, creating a residual over‑valuation zone for short‑term traders.  
• TWAP baseline is implicitly anchored at the regression fair value, with a residual band that suggests a potential upside to $4.00 before a re‑valuation cycle.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
• Machine‑learning forecast places a non‑panic floor at $1.50; a major panic could push the floor to $1.60 over the next 10 weeks.  
• Bull‑case target from the three‑standard‑deviation model is $3.40, while the 2030 cycle bull target is projected at $20.00 (≈8× current price).  
• Bear‑market floor for the 400‑day cycle (starting Oct 2025) is $1.70, with a panic floor of $1.45 and a worst‑case floor of $1.25 (~50% drop from today).  
• The 20‑week SMA’s flattening signals a potential upturn, but the price remains below the 100‑ and 200‑week SMAs, suggesting short‑term downside risk until a breakout above these averages occurs.
